immortalised fibroblasts from these mice were made to contain tamoxifen-inducible CreERT2, which catalyzes the functional ablation of both copies of GPx4 and resulting in a complete knockout of GPx4, a massive ROS burst, and cell death in cell culture. These cells (Pfa1 cells) were used to characterize compounds of the present invention, whereby tamoxifen (TAM) was given on day 0 along with the compound under test, and 72 hours later cell survival was evaluated using AlamarBlue.
